subject: Owner-proposed attribute framework to break the equivalence-class collapse
verdict: The method is sound and needs far less than proposed. The proposed DATA SOURCE is the one source this project permanently excluded. A licence-clean source already exists inside the project and was validated.

F1_the_method_works_and_needs_only_three.test: Appended k continuous attributes with distinct values to D and recounted equivalence classes.
F1_the_method_works_and_needs_only_three.conclusion: Three continuous attributes with distinct values fully break the collapse. The 16-attribute schema is far more than required. The bottleneck is entirely the provenance of the numbers, not the architecture or the mathematics.

F2_the_proposed_measurement_model_would_.test: Built the proposed 16-attribute matrix with the specified defaults: 6 binary attributes derived from dimensions, 10 continuous attributes at their default 0.5.
F2_the_proposed_measurement_model_would_.finding: The metrics move in contradictory directions. Spectral gap improves ninefold while participation ratio collapses and max class size does not move at all. The constant 0.5 columns contribute a rank-one component that inflates the largest eigenvalue.
F2_the_proposed_measurement_model_would_.consequence: Reporting spectral gap as the headline would declare success while discrimination is unchanged. max_class_size is the metric that tracks the real property; spectral gap alone is actively misleading when constant columns are present.
F2_the_proposed_measurement_model_would_.recommended_guard: Never report spectral gap without max_class_size and per-column variance beside it.

F3_the_proposed_source_is_the_permanentl.proposal: ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA assigns "source": "SCA Flavor Wheel" to all ten continuous attributes.
F3_the_proposed_source_is_the_permanentl.conflict: The SCA/WCR Coffee Taster's Flavor Wheel is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. ND forbids derivative works, and encoding its structure as numeric attribute values is a derivative. It sits on this project's permanent exclusion list as SCA_WCR_ND_OR_PERSONAL_DOWNLOAD.
F3_the_proposed_source_is_the_permanentl.related: The WCR Sensory Lexicon is offered for free personal-use download and printing, which is not a reuse licence either.
F3_the_proposed_source_is_the_permanentl.consequence: Adopting the schema as written would encode the one source the project can never use, and would end its provenance defensibility.
F3_the_proposed_source_is_the_permanentl.alternative_if_owner_authored: Owner-assigned numbers would be the subjective evaluation the project forbids as a model or architecture input.

F4_a_licence_clean_source_already_exists.asset: packages/flavor-data/src/descriptors.ts in the public frontend repository

structure.form: min / typical / max ranges on a 0 to 5 scale
structure.bilingual: labels carry en and zhHans, which also addresses the output-side CN/EN requirement

F4_a_licence_clean_source_already_exists.finding: The project's own attribute data fully resolves the collapse on every descriptor it covers.
F4_a_licence_clean_source_already_exists.gap: 14 of 59 registry descriptors are covered. Extending the existing framework to the remaining 45 is 270 values.
F4_a_licence_clean_source_already_exists.why_this_is_not_a_new_class_of_decision: The project already made this exact editorial judgement 24 times, under its own licence, labelled project_curated_draft rather than measurement. Extending it continues an existing practice rather than importing a forbidden source.
F4_a_licence_clean_source_already_exists.comparison: 270 values is the same order of magnitude as the roughly 60 rule approvals R12C priced, and both are owner-throughput problems rather than external supply problems.

F5_unresolved_the_output_budget_degenera.observation: At 11 equivalence classes, emitting 3 main plus 5 secondary means emitting 8 of 11 classes, 73% of the entire space. That is enumeration, not recommendation.
F5_unresolved_the_output_budget_degenera.status: Resolves automatically IF attributes are extended, since classes return to 59. Remains a live defect if they are not.
F5_unresolved_the_output_budget_degenera.note: The 3+5 budget in PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1 was set against 59 distinguishable descriptors and is degenerate against 11.

F6_the_fork_that_has_never_been_named.question: Does the product actually require within-class discrimination?
F6_the_fork_that_has_never_been_named.why_it_matters: The product exists for people who can tell two coffees differ but lack words. Moving someone from no words to 'citrus-family' already delivers that. Whether bergamot must be separated from blackcurrant has never been asked.
F6_the_fork_that_has_never_been_named.branch_no: The 11 classes are the honest output granularity, attribute expansion is unnecessary, and the entire collapse problem dissolves. The budget must change to suit 11 classes.
F6_the_fork_that_has_never_been_named.branch_yes: Attributes are required, and the only licence-clean route is extending the project's own framework by 270 values.
F6_the_fork_that_has_never_been_named.recommendation: Settle this before further architecture work. One branch makes all of it moot.

F7_non_monotonic_reasoning.owner_point: Dempster-Shafer accumulates monotonically and cannot express a user changing their mind. Q1 fruity then Q2 nutty then Q3 fruity is treated as conflicting simultaneous evidence rather than revision.
F7_non_monotonic_reasoning.assessment: Correct. Accumulation and revision are different operations and DS only implements the first.
options: use a belief-revision framework where later evidence can retract earlier commitments
treat repetition as confirmation and alternation as an explicit revision signal in the question policy rather than in the evidence layer
F7_non_monotonic_reasoning.status: Real, but downstream of F6. Deferred, not dismissed.
